svg.title: tsrs vs bun check vs tsgo
svg.desc: Summed over 17 TypeScript projects · 4 threads each · 16-vCPU Linux machine. Check time: tsrs 11.9 s, bun check 35.7 s, tsgo 78.4 s. Peak memory: tsrs 12.6 GiB, bun check 15.4 GiB, tsgo 52.3 GiB. Shorter is better. Per project: vscode: tsrs 2.14 s, 1.80 GiB; bun check 4.28 s, 1.50 GiB; tsgo 10.42 s, 7.50 GiB. xstate-main: tsrs 0.16 s, 0.25 GiB; bun check 0.30 s, 0.30 GiB; tsgo 0.83 s, 0.72 GiB. webpack: tsrs 0.26 s, 0.40 GiB; bun check 0.49 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.32 s, 1.15 GiB. mui-docs: tsrs 1.01 s, 1.06 GiB; bun check 9.20 s, 5.37 GiB; tsgo 12.05 s, 7.34 GiB. Compiler: tsrs 0.06 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.10 s, 0.12 GiB; tsgo 0.27 s, 0.22 GiB. Compiler-Unions: tsrs 0.09 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.20 s, 0.13 GiB; tsgo 0.53 s, 0.24 GiB. cal-diy: tsrs 1.00 s, 1.15 GiB; bun check 3.00 s, 0.92 GiB; tsgo 5.66 s, 4.42 GiB. formbricks-web: tsrs 1.16 s, 1.45 GiB; bun check 2.43 s, 1.33 GiB; tsgo 6.94 s, 5.49 GiB. supabase-studio: tsrs 1.21 s, 1.19 GiB; bun check 3.51 s, 0.89 GiB; tsgo 6.74 s, 4.43 GiB. t3code-server: tsrs 1.54 s, 1.18 GiB; bun check 3.49 s, 1.01 GiB; tsgo 13.40 s, 6.17 GiB. mikro-orm: tsrs 1.57 s, 1.40 GiB; bun check 4.78 s, 0.76 GiB; tsgo 10.09 s, 6.35 GiB. next-packages-next: tsrs 0.44 s, 0.55 GiB; bun check 0.89 s, 0.50 GiB; tsgo 2.93 s, 1.79 GiB. next-root: tsrs 0.29 s, 0.40 GiB; bun check 0.60 s, 0.42 GiB; tsgo 1.53 s, 1.26 GiB. storybook: tsrs 0.26 s, 0.39 GiB; bun check 0.53 s, 0.45 GiB; tsgo 1.61 s, 1.37 GiB. nuxt: tsrs 0.24 s, 0.38 GiB; bun check 0.68 s, 0.40 GiB; tsgo 1.26 s, 1.13 GiB. playwright: tsrs 0.22 s, 0.34 GiB; bun check 0.43 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.11 s, 1.05 GiB. drizzle-orm: tsrs 0.27 s, 0.50 GiB; bun check 0.75 s, 0.53 GiB; tsgo 1.75 s, 1.72 GiB. tsgo and tsrs with --checkers 4, bun check with --threads 4. Median of 10 interleaved runs (3 for tsgo). tsrs uses PGO-optimized dist build, built like the npm release binaries. Machine: Depot CI depot-ubuntu-24.04-16 (16 vCPU, 63 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 9R45 96-Core Processor). Measured 2026-10-16 06:28 UTC; tsrs commit f0f8b7a9e74e637c43136abed216d2019085206a. TypeScript 7.0.2; TypeScript reference b85298b6a81f772d080b0455de0ca9d744cd6fd6.
